# Gytha

## Personality

Tough, sharp-tongued and quick to laugh. She can scrub a stain and a reputation clean.

## Story

Gytha runs the washing yard in a courtyard of the old quarters and knows every household's linen and secrets. She is raising her son with her parents' help and wants him to learn a trade, not a sword.
